license_required.quote: a person or firm desiring to practice any board-regulated profession or occupation shall first secure a certificate or registration and shall comply with all the conditions prescribed in this chapter

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the state board of technical registration.

name.quote: "Board" means the state board of technical registration.

type.quote: The state board of technical registration is established consisting of members who are appointed by the governor as follows: 1. One architect. 2. One professional engineer. ... 4. One landscape architect. 5. One geologist. 6. One land surveyor.

degree_required.value: graduate of a school approved by the board or have four years or more of education or experience, or both, in work in the profession
degree_required.quote: Be a graduate of a school approved by the board or have four years or more of education or experience, or both, in work in the profession in which registration is sought that meets standards specified by the board in its rules.

accrediting_body.quote: a school approved by the board

degree_level.quote: Be a graduate of a school approved by the board or have four years or more of education or experience, or both, in work in the profession in which registration is sought

school_approval_basis.quote: a school approved by the board

credential_pegged.quote: Be a graduate of a school approved by the board or have four years or more of education or experience, or both, in work in the profession in which registration is sought that meets standards specified by the board in its rules.

required.quote: Be actively engaged in education or experience, or both, in the profession for which registration is sought for at least eight years.

experience_source.quote: Be actively engaged in education or experience, or both, in the profession for which registration is sought for at least eight years.

duration.value: at least eight years (with up to five years credited for approved schooling)
duration.quote: Be actively engaged in education or experience, or both, in the profession for which registration is sought for at least eight years.

kind.value: active engagement in engineering education or experience under direct supervision of a registered professional
kind.quote: experience credited by the board under this section and sections 32-101, 32-122 and 32-126 must be attained under the direct supervision of a professional who is satisfactory to the board and registered in this state, another state or a foreign country in the profession in which the applicant is seeking registration

exams.name: Engineer-in-Training Examination
exams.notes: In-training exam required before professional registration; may be waived under section 32-126 for experienced applicants
exams.jurisdiction: national (administered via national council or professional association approved by the board)
exams.quote: Unless exempt under section 32-126, pass the applicable in-training and professional examinations in the profession in which registration is sought.

exams.name: Professional Engineer Examination
exams.notes: Professional exam required; may be waived under section 32-126
exams.jurisdiction: national (administered via national council or professional association approved by the board)
exams.quote: Unless exempt under section 32-126, pass the applicable in-training and professional examinations in the profession in which registration is sought.

interval_years.quote: a new application shall be filed each year by the firm within thirty days of the anniversary date of the original firm registration.

available.quote: An applicant for professional registration as a professional engineer, architect, land surveyor or landscape architect in this state through reciprocity or endorsement shall hold both of the following: 1. A valid license, registration or certification issued by the proper authority of either: (a) Another state, territory, district or possession. (b) A country participating in the applicable profession's national council mutual recognition agreement. 2. A certification or model law designation from the applicable profession's national council.

requirements.value: Must hold a valid license/registration/certification from another state/territory/district/possession or qualifying country, plus a certification or model law designation from the applicable profession's national council, and must hold a record from the national council verifying at least four years of post-licensure experience, or passing a professional national examination, or earning a baccalaureate or equivalent/postgraduate degree.
requirements.quote: an applicant for registration as a: 1. Professional engineer through reciprocity or endorsement shall hold a record from the profession's national council verifying that the person meets at least one of the following in the branch of engineering in which registration is sought: (a) Has at least four years of experience following the person's licensure, registration or certification by the other jurisdiction. (b) Passed a professional national examination. (c) Earned a baccalaureate or equivalent degree or a postgraduate degree.

exists.quote: The state board of technical registration is established consisting of members who are appointed by the governor as follows: 1. One architect. 2. One professional engineer. 3. Six public members. 4. One landscape architect. 5. One geologist. 6. One land surveyor.

regulatory_model.quote: a person or firm desiring to practice any board-regulated profession or occupation shall first secure a certificate or registration and shall comply with all the conditions prescribed in this chapter

credential_type.quote: "Professional engineer" means a person who, by reason of special knowledge of the mathematical and physical sciences and the principles and methods of engineering analysis and design acquired by professional education and practical experience, is qualified to practice engineering and is registered as a professional engineer pursuant to this chapter.

is_mandatory.quote: a person or firm desiring to practice any board-regulated profession or occupation shall first secure a certificate or registration and shall comply with all the conditions prescribed in this chapter

title_protection.quote: Uses "certified", "professional certified", "professional", "PE", "registered", "registered professional" or "professional registered" in conjunction with any board regulated profession or occupation if the person is not certified or registered as provided by this chapter.

scope_protection.quote: Practices, offers to practice or by any implication holds himself out as qualified to practice any board regulated profession or occupation if the person is not registered or certified as provided by this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or misrepresentation in obtaining a certificate of qualification, whether in the application or qualification examination.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or misrepresentation in obtaining a certificate of qualification, whether in the application or qualification examination.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence, incompetence, bribery or other misconduct in the practice of the profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross negligence, incompetence, bribery or other misconduct in the practice of the profession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting an unregistered or uncertified person to evade this chapter or conspiring with such a person, or allowing one's registration to be used by an unregistered person.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting an unregistered or uncertified person to evade this chapter or knowingly combining or conspiring with an unregistered or uncertified person, or allowing one's registration or certification to be used by an unregistered or uncertified person or acting as agent, partner, associate or otherwise of an unregistered or uncertified person, with intent to evade this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of this chapter or board rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of this chapter or board rules.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to pay a collaborating registered professional within seven calendar days after the registrant receives payment from a client, unless contractually specified otherwise.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to pay a collaborating registered professional within seven calendar days after the registrant receives payment from a client unless specified otherwise contractually between the prime professional and the collaborating registered professional.

definition_quote.value: Engineering practice means any professional service or creative work requiring engineering education, training and experience in applying engineering principles and interpreting engineering data to engineering activities that clearly impact the health, safety and welfare of the public and the engineering design of buildings, structures, products, machines, processes and systems to the extent that the engineering education, training and experience requirements prescribed by sections 32-122 and 32-122.01 are necessary to protect the health, safety and welfare of the public.
definition_quote.quote: "Engineering practice" means any professional service or creative work requiring engineering education, training and experience in applying engineering principles and interpreting engineering data to engineering activities that clearly impact the health, safety and welfare of the public and the engineering design of buildings, structures, products, machines, processes and systems to the extent that the engineering education, training and experience requirements prescribed by sections 32-122 and 32-122.01 are necessary to protect the health, safety and welfare of the public.

value: reviewing construction or other design products for monitoring compliance
methods_authorized.quote: The services or creative work may include providing planning services, studies, designs, design coordination, drawings, specifications and other technical submissions, surveying as prescribed in paragraph 22, subdivisions (d) and (e) of this subsection, and reviewing construction or other design products for the purposes of monitoring compliance with drawings and specifications related to engineered works.

covers_land_surveying.quote: "Land surveyor" means a person who by reason of knowledge of the mathematical and physical sciences, principles of land surveying and evidence gathering acquired by professional education or practical experience, or both, is qualified to practice land surveying as attested by registration as a land surveyor.

covers_geology.quote: "Geologist" means a person, who is not required to be a professional engineer, who by reason of special knowledge of the earth sciences and the principles and methods of search for and appraisal of mineral or other natural resources acquired by professional education and practical experience is qualified to practice geology as attested by registration as a professional geologist.

engineer_intern_certificate_available.quote: "Engineer-in-training" means a candidate for registration as a professional engineer who both: (a) Is a graduate in an approved engineering curriculum of four years or more of a school approved by the board or has four years or more of education or experience, or both, in engineering work that meets standards specified by the board in its rules. (b) Has passed the engineer-in-training examination.

surveyor_in_training_certificate_availab.quote: "Land surveyor-in-training" means a candidate for registration as a professional land surveyor who both: (a) Is a graduate of a school and curriculum approved by the board or has four years or more of education or experience, or both, in land surveying work that meets standards specified by the board in its rules. (b) Has passed the land surveyor-in-training examination.

geologist_in_training_certificate_availa.quote: "Geologist-in-training" means a candidate for registration as a professional geologist who both: (a) Is a graduate of a school approved by the board or has four years or more of education or experience, or both, in geological work that meets standards specified by the board in its rules. (b) Has passed the geologist-in-training examination.

postgraduate_degree_experience_credit_ye.quote: Each year of study that is satisfactorily completed in an architectural, engineering, geological or landscape architectural school approved by the board is equivalent to one year of active engagement up to a maximum of five years.

responsible_charge_defined.quote: A firm shall not engage in the practice of any board-regulated profession or occupation unless the firm is registered with the board and the professional services are conducted under the full authority and responsible charge of a principal of the firm, who is also a registrant.

seal_required_on_documents.quote: Plans, specifications, plats or reports prepared by a registrant or a registrant's bona fide employee shall be issued under the registrant's seal if the board requires the registrant to use a seal.

seal_document_types.quote: Plans, specifications, plats or reports prepared by a registrant or a registrant's bona fide employee shall be issued under the registrant's seal if the board requires the registrant to use a seal.

firm_practice_allowed.quote: A firm shall not engage in the practice of any board-regulated profession or occupation unless the firm is registered with the board and the professional services are conducted under the full authority and responsible charge of a principal of the firm, who is also a registrant.

exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Professions and occupations that are regulated by the board may be practiced without compliance with the requirements of this chapter by: 1. An officer or employee of the United States, practicing as such. 2. An employee of a registrant or of a person that is exempt from registration, if such employment does not involve direct responsibility for design, inspection or supervision.

code_of_ethics_in_statute.quote: The board may adopt rules establishing rules of professional conduct for registrants.

board_member_responsible_charge_years_re.quote: Each member who is an architect, a geologist, a landscape architect, a professional engineer or a land surveyor shall have at least five years' active professional experience as attested by registration under this chapter.

retired_status_license_available.quote: A registrant who retires from the active practice of any board-regulated profession or occupation or who is not currently practicing that board-regulated profession or occupation in this state may request that the board place the registrant's certificate of registration or certification on inactive status.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Federal government officers and employees practicing engineering in official capacity
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: An officer or employee of the United States, practicing as such.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Contractors executing work designed by a licensed engineer (construction execution only)
Building trades workers, craft workers, and construction superintendents/supervisors/inspectors performing customary duties
Employees or subordinates working under direct supervision of a licensed engineer
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: An employee of a registrant or of a person that is exempt from registration, if such employment does not involve direct responsibility for design, inspection or supervision.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Engineers-in-training / engineer interns acting under supervision
Land surveyor interns
Teaching engineering, architectural, landscape architectural, or surveying courses at accredited institutions
Regulated transportation companies and public utilities (and their officers and employees) performing engineering for their own facilities
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: The requirements of this chapter do not apply to work done by any communications common carrier or its affiliates or any public service corporation or manufacturing industry or by full-time employees of any of them if such work is in connection with or incidental to the products, systems or nonengineering services of the communications common carrier or its affiliates or public service corporation or manufacturing industry and if the engineering service is not offered directly to the public.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Engineering services incidental to the practice of architecture by licensed architects and their subordinates
Engineering services incidental to the practice of geology by licensed geologists and their subordinates
Practice of any other legally recognized profession or trade
Manufacturing, mining, public utility, research and development, or other industrial corporations performing engineering work incidental to their own products, systems, or services
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: The requirements of this chapter do not apply to work done by any communications common carrier or its affiliates or any public service corporation or manufacturing industry or by full-time employees of any of them if such work is in connection with or incidental to the products, systems or nonengineering services of the communications common carrier or its affiliates or public service corporation or manufacturing industry and if the engineering service is not offered directly to the public.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Firms performing engineering services for themselves or their own subsidiaries/affiliates (in-house engineering)
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: A nonregistrant who designs buildings or structures to be erected on property owned or leased by the nonregistrant or by a person, firm or corporation, including a utility, telephone, mining or railroad company, that employs the nonregistrant on a full-time basis, if the buildings or structures are intended solely for the use of the owner or lessee of the property, are not ordinarily occupied by more than twenty people, are not for sale to, rental to or use by the public

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Nonresident persons, firms, or corporations meeting specified out-of-state criteria
Real estate brokers or salespersons making appraisals and valuations of real estate
Alterations or repairs to buildings not affecting structural system or public health, safety, or welfare
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: A nonregistrant who designs additions or alterations to a one or two story building or structure subject to the limitations set forth in paragraph 4 of this subsection.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Single-family and small residential dwellings of limited size
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: A nonregistrant who designs, alters or adds to either of the following: (a) A detached single-family dwelling. (b) An individual unit in a multifamily dwelling if the walls that are designed, altered or added in the unit are not bearing walls, shear walls or firewalls

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Agricultural work not required to be of public record
Revegetation, restoration, reclamation, rehabilitation, or erosion control for disturbed land not affecting public health, safety, or welfare
Maintenance or placement of plant material not affecting public health, safety, or welfare
Horticultural consultants and persons preparing planting plans for plant installations
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: A nonregistrant who provides horticultural consultations or prepares planting plans for plant installations.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Authorized designers of fire protection systems
Holders of temporary permits for engineering practice
Corporations, partnerships, LLCs, and LLPs offering professional engineering services through licensed principals (business entity exemption with certificate of authorization)
Government employees inspecting residential structures as part of official duties
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: A person who is employed by a governmental entity from inspecting residential structures if the inspection is within official duties and responsibilities.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Persons performing home inspections solely for lender construction monitoring
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: A person from performing a home inspection if the inspection will be used solely by a bank, savings and loan association or credit union to monitor progress on the construction of a residential structure, unless otherwise required by federal law or regulation.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Property managers inspecting their own managed residential structures without separate compensation
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: A person who is employed as a property manager for a residential structure and whose official duties and responsibilities include inspecting the residential structure from performing a home inspection on the structure if the person does not receive separate compensation for the inspection work.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Small public works projects below a specified expenditure threshold
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: A nonregistrant who designs a water or wastewater treatment plant, or extensions, additions, modifications or revisions, or extensions to water distribution or collection systems, if the total cost of such construction does not exceed $12,500.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Licensed geologists practicing geology (not required to hold engineer license)
scope__exemptions_from_licensure.quote: A trained geologist may engage in a geological practice without being registered under this chapter.

scope__exemptions_from_licensure.item: Persons with grandfathered or legacy licensure status in discontinued engineering branch titles
Boundary surveys on private land not intended as basis for engineering design
Professional engineers or engineer interns granted inactive status
Senior licensed professional engineers exempt from continuing education requirements
